title: Mathematically modeling worried-well behavior during infectious disease outbreaks
role: Defines the four-compartment baseline and behavioural regimes
limitation: Provides synthetic early-outbreak dynamics but does not estimate consultation capacity

title: Worried well and COVID-19: re-emergence of an old quandary
role: Explains clinical and healthcare-system relevance of worried-well demand
limitation: Conceptual clinical discussion rather than an optimization study

title: Coronaphobia: fear and the 2019-nCoV outbreak
role: Supports the role of anxiety and perceived risk during an emerging outbreak
limitation: Does not provide a compartmental resource-planning model

title: On a basic model of a two-disease epidemic
role: Provides the two-process modelling foundation cited by Singh and Gromov
limitation: Models interacting transmission processes but not worried-well capacity demand

title: Release immediately or sequentially? Strategies for allocating scarce therapeutic resources during disease outbreaks
role: Connects outbreak timing to scarce healthcare resource decisions
limitation: Addresses release policies rather than a classical newsvendor capacity decision

title: The newsvendor problem: Review and directions for future research
role: Provides the critical-fractile foundation and major newsvendor extensions
limitation: The present project deliberately uses only the classical single-resource form
